description: Brentuximab vedotin is recommended as an option for treating CD30-positive Hodgkin lymphoma in adults with relapsed or refractory disease who have either already had autologous stem cell transplant, or already had at least 2 previous therapies when autologous stem cell transplant or multi-agent chemotherapy are not suitable. It is recommended only if the company provides brentuximab vedotin according to the commercial arrangement.
